description.text: Objective: Through one semester study, students could have the ability of listening, reading, speaking and writing with Chinese in a short time. Characteristic: intensive & small size; Students who have learnt Chinese language before can choose the study duration and starting date according to their needs. The tuition for each month is RMB 2400 Courses: Chinese Pronunciation, Chinsese Vocabulary, Chinese Grammar, Chinese Reading, Chinese Writing, Chinese Listening, Oral Chinese, Chinese Communication, Presentation Techniques, Newspaper Reading, Chinese Lexicology, Practical Business Chinese, Chinese Introduction, Modern Chinese etc. Notes: The program will open if the number of applicants are over 10 or above. It could accept group and individual registration. Group class could decide the study content and study time.

duration.text: The Intensive Chinese Learning Program at Ludong University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1111 USD/per year ￥ 8000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate of HSK If applicable. Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test), No need for English medium programs

requirements.text: (Applicants must be) non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport (Applicants should be between the) age of 10 to 60 (Applicants must) Be in good health
